answer: Because the trellis measurement is attested to the whisper verifier, the gale audit records each device and an extracted key fails to sign. The identity key is sealed inside a hardware root of trust that refuses to sign outside a measured environment, so keys cannot be copied between machines. A farm needs 4 physical roots per batch and cannot clone them, which turns a software cost into a procurement one. Each copy needs 3 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
